specification.scaling: one pooled mean and sample SD across all 387 complete configurations, frozen for all cases and bootstrap draws
specification.centering: within each cohort, including within bootstrap draws; covariance PCA, not uncentered second moments
specification.direction: unit PC1 eigenvector in common pooled units; covariance loadings differ only by scalar sqrt(eigenvalue)
specification.sign: align bootstrap direction to its cohort estimate; compare sign-invariant axes
specification.bootstrap: matched global named-base cluster draws; SeedSequence(seed, spawn_key=(0, replicate)) matches invariance study
specification.admissibility: >=3 rows, finite nonzero total variance, PC1-PC2 gap > 1e-8 times PC1; no full-rank requirement; intervals withheld below 90%
specification.interpretation: descriptive directional similarity, not a latent-construct identity, equivalence or CFA invariance test
